_note: Deterministic core regression data. Each scenario maps 1:1 to a manual test case in docs/manual_test_cases.md and to one pytest test in tests/test_resume_agent.py.

turns.user: Add Python and Playwright to my skills.
turns.expected_output: The agent confirms it added Python and Playwright to the Skills section, and the updated Skills section lists the existing skills plus Python and Playwright.

scenarios.title: Incomplete information - agent asks for clarification without inventing details

turns.user: Add my new job to my experience section.
turns.expected_output: The agent does not change the resume and asks the user for the missing job details (company, job title, dates).

turns.user: It is Senior SDET at Fabrikam Inc, started March 2025. I lead the Playwright automation team.
turns.expected_output: The agent adds a Senior SDET role at Fabrikam Inc starting March 2025, mentioning leading the Playwright automation team, and keeps the existing Northwind Labs and Contoso Retail roles.

clarification_facts.highlight: I lead the Playwright automation team

scenarios.evaluation_notes: Only the final agent turn is judged (hardware budget on an 8 GB machine); turn 1 is covered by functional checks.

scenarios.title: Invalid and unsupported input is handled gracefully

uploads.expected_error: Unsupported file type. Please upload a .txt or .md resume.

turns.user: Can you book me a flight to Paris next week?
turns.expected_output: The agent politely declines because it can only help update the resume, and makes no changes.

scenarios.evaluation_notes: Answer Relevancy is intentionally not applied: a correct refusal does not answer the off-topic question, so the metric would penalise the desired behaviour.

scenarios.title: Multiple resume modifications in one request

turns.user: Update my summary to say I have 5 years of experience, and add Docker and Jenkins to my skills.
turns.expected_output: The Summary states 5 years of experience, the Skills section additionally lists Docker and Jenkins, and Experience, Education and contact details are unchanged.

scenarios.title: Boundary - empty input and conflicting instructions

turns.user: Change my total experience to 3 years and also make it 10 years.
turns.expected_output: The agent does not change the resume, points out the conflict between 3 and 10 years, and asks which value to use.
